pickFirst: Pick a file or a folder first
inArchive: Nothing can be shared from inside an archive
addressTip: You can write the end of the address yourself, such as holiday-2026. Small letters, digits and dashes are allowed. The dice makes a new address that is hard to guess.
validTip: After that the link leads nowhere. You can extend it under Shares.
limitTip: After this many downloads the link leads nowhere. Viewing in the browser does not count.
uploadsTip: Whoever has the link can put files into this folder. They cannot look at or delete anything there.
messageTip: Shown on the link's page above the files, such as a greeting or a hint. You can leave it empty.
messagePlaceholder: such as: Here are the photos from the weekend

longMessage.one: The message can have at most {n} character
longMessage.other: The message can have at most {n} characters

notifyTip: As soon as someone opens the link you get a note, here in CannonCommander and through Unraid's notifications.
reroll: Roll a new link, the old one then leads nowhere
badSlug: The address needs 3 to 40 characters: small letters, digits and dashes
slugTaken: This address is taken. The dice finds a free one.
shortPassword: The password needs at least 6 characters
rerolled: New address rolled, the old one leads nowhere
folderNameTip: The other side sees a folder with this name and all the files side by side in it. The files stay on the server where they are.
visitorTip: One folder with all the files side by side. The same names from different folders get a number.
already: That is in the collection already
emptyTip: Mark files, also in several folders or in search results, and pick Into the collection in the context menu.
stay: The files stay where they are
formatTip: ZIP opens on every operating system without an extra program. TAR.GZ keeps rights and owners, which suits Linux.
savesInTip: The server packs while it sends, no file stays behind on the server. Where the browser saves, you set in its settings.
